_comment: Illustrative worked example — brand-neutralised from the validated 'drinkable collagen' offer-ad run. Copy the STRUCTURE, never the creative values: the headline angle (copy.headline_words / subline / motif_chip — the demo used the category-killer 'X IS OVER. the new way') and the music mood (music.prompt — the demo used punchy lo-fi pop, 115 BPM) come from the format recipe's choices (headline_angle, music); palette, product photo, claims and CTA are brand facts. The recipe binds a NEW brand's own product photo / palette / copy / music here. Replace every /abs/or/working/... path with a REAL absolute path or a runtime working/ path. ALL text is typeset in the engine (never AI-rendered). The ONLY composited bitmap is the REAL product photo (objectFit:contain, never stretched) — an AI-rendered packshot is an instant fail.

_notes.cta_label: Do NOT end cta_label with an arrow — Scene04 appends its own '→' (render.py also strips a stray trailing arrow, but keep the source clean).
_notes.mechanism_prop: One of TWO engine presets only: 'spoon' (drinkable/liquid) or 'accent' (neutral bar; use for SaaS/software & anything non-CPG). Not arbitrary SVG.
_notes.product_format: Optional. Physical: liquid/powder/capsule/gummy/cream/serum. Digital: software/saas/app. Omit for a product that fits none → the claim-matches-format gate skips.
_notes.saas: For a SaaS/software product: product_hero_image = a REAL app UI screenshot (keeps its own bg — fine), product_format = 'saas', mechanism_prop = 'accent'.

music.prompt: punchy lo-fi pop, confident, brand-forward, 115 BPM, instrumental only, no vocals
music._prompt_note: prompt is for create-music-elevenlabs (from choices.music); render.py only reads bed.
